body: Two ewes down with bearing trouble behind the yards, had to put them down.
Lost a cow calving overnight, couldn't get to her in time.
Docked 1,240 lambs. Good tally considering the cold spring.
Cold snap after docking - picked up a dozen dead lambs across the flats.
Found 3 ewes cast in the swamp paddock, all dead. Fenced it off.
62 calves on the ground, calling that calving done.
Killed 2 lambs for the freezer.
